test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 30 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who administers the oath to the President of India?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Chief Justice of India.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Chief Justice of India administers the oath of office to the President.
 
• The affidavit to the President is administered by **the Chief Justice of India** and in his absence, the seniormost judge of the Supreme Court is available.
 
• The Chief Justice of India (CJI) is **the head of the judiciary of India and the Supreme Court of India**.
 
• As head of the supreme court, the chief justice is responsible for the **allocation of cases and appointment of constitutional benches.**
 
• As of December 2022, Justice Dhananjaya Yashwant Chandrachud is the 50th Chief Justice of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f9ac1fe4809f09c615443191d11e77fb8d060867d2769150081b9bde1a9ea30.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The prime minister** can be a member of the** Lok Sabha or of the Rajya Sabha,** the upper house of the parliament. ​
 
• The** Vice President** is elected indirectly by members of an electoral college consisting of the members of **both houses of the Parliament of India.**
 
• Article 76 of the constitution mentions that the **Attorney General of India**** is the highest law officer in India.**
